name: governed-prompt-step
description: Demonstrates the opt-in Copilot governance controls on a Prompt step: a permission policy that denies shell + network tool calls, a filesystem/network sandbox, and human-in-the-loop routing for the agent's elicitation and plan-approval requests. All three are opt-in; remove a field to restore the autonomous default. Note: sandbox paths are passed to the runtime verbatim (not template-resolved), and the sandbox is enforced on Linux/macOS.

question.description: The review question to ask the read-only agent.

steps.name: review
steps.systemPrompt: You are a read-only code reviewer. Inspect files under the working directory and answer the question. Do not run shell commands, fetch URLs, or modify files. If you need a decision from the operator, ask.
